en: The road east is blocked by a sleeping Pokémon. It's been snoring there for days!
text: Drumul spre est e blocat de un Pokémon adormit. Sforăie acolo de zile întregi!

en: The view from upstairs is something. Have a look through the binoculars.
text: Priveliștea de sus e ceva. Uită-te prin binoclu.
